summary_md: **(((JReuben1))) ([@jreuben1](https://x.com/jreuben1/status/2116444925633958390))** highlights *Beyond Tokens* by Yingzhuo Liu ([arXiv 2606.05711](https://arxiv.org/html/2606.05711v3)), a unified framework for latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems, and surveys approaches like LatentMAS, Interlat and SCALE-COMM that exchange hidden states instead of text to cut cost and information loss.

referenced_urls.title: Beyond Tokens: A Unified Framework forLatent Communication in LLM-basedMulti-Agent Systems
